text:
mira: Quick thread — need alignment on pilot gating for the inference toolkit (batching / caching / quantization recommendations / eval-triggered alerts). Two pilot customers pushing for alpha. Goal: decide acceptance criteria + scope by EOD Thurs.

sam: +1. I sketched an MVP acceptance set — short list so engineering can scope: 1) batching recs produce measurable latency/cost estimates; 2) caching suggestions with a way to measure prefix hit rate; 3) quantization guidance includes expected accuracy & cost deltas; 4) eval-alerts pipeline that can trigger when a chosen metric regresses >5%.

leo: For quant recs we need a model compatibility matrix and quick empirical deltas (int8/int4 where supported). I have bench numbers for a few models, can share. Important: call out which models we won't recommend quant for.

anya: From CS: customers want an "explain why" UI for any recommendation and an easy toggle to accept/rollback per route. They also expect a 2-week pilot dashboard + weekly checkpoints.

jordan: Sales note — two AEs asked for a canary path with SLA-like targets (p50/p95 latency) and a safe-mode fallback that sends traffic to hosted model if things degrade. They'll sign pilots if rollback & runbook exist.

sam: Proposal for concrete acceptance tests (smoke):
```bash
# example smoke check - returns recommendations + simple metrics
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/inference-toolkit/recs 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  -d '{"route":"chat", "seq_len":512, "model":"mistral-7b"}' 
# expect: {"batching_recs": [...], "expected_p50_ms": < 100, "cache_hit_delta": ">=10%"} 
```

mira: From prioritization pov we must ship: observability hooks (per-route token & latency breakdown), per-route config + rollouts, rollback controls, and docs/runbook. Without those customers won't sign.

leo: Add: eval harness integration is required for the alerts piece — alerts must map to eval sets and be configurable per pilot. I can deliver a trimmed harness if we limit eval types to latency & two quality metrics.

anya: Customer acceptance checklist (CS): 1) pilot onboarding doc + runbook, 2) 2-week pilot with dashboard showing baseline vs pilot metrics, 3) rollback plan & contact list, 4) SRE signoff on fallback.

sam: Rough dev estimate: core rec engine + API = 4w, quant benchmarking (parallel) = 2w, dashboard + eval hooks = 2w. Total-ish 6w with parallel work; could compress with 1 sprint of focused pairing.

mira: Decision ask: can eng commit to minimal alpha that includes: batching recs API, caching suggestion API with a measurement endpoint, a tiny quant-reporting API (no auto-apply), eval-trigger alert framework (configurable threshold), and a pilot runbook? If yes we'll mark scope and commit customers.

jordan: :thumbsup: I can coordinate pilot contracts and confirm SLO targets with AEs.

leo: I volunteer to own model compatibility table + the eval harness bits. Will post numbers by Tue.

sam: I'll own the rec APIs and the smoke test harness. Need clarity on what "explain why" means for UI — doc or short json field?

anya: Prefer short JSON explanation + human-readable sentence. E.g., "reason":"high prefix reuse detected; expected token savings ~23%". That is enough for pilot users.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled a planning window for potential pilot deploy on 2024-05-10 22:00 UTC.

mira: OK — locking tentative scope to the minimal alpha above unless objections. Please react with :thumbsup: if you can deliver, or list blockers. Lock deadline: scope sign-off by EOD Thu.
